title: Detroit Costs You 33¢ an Hour. Worth It?
caption:
Detroit: Become Human is $3.99 on Steam this week (90% off $39.99) and the main story takes about 12 hours: 33¢ an hour. Full price is $3.33 an hour. A $12 movie ticket for 2 hours is $6 an hour. Our own math.
Which game should we price next?

Sources: Steam store (US price, 26 Nov), HowLongToBeat
ig_first_line: Send this to the friend who got the worst ending in Detroit: it's $3.99 this week, 33¢ an hour.
